answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-bonded identity with escalating minimums: each new agent must lock a bond that rises with network size, so launching N sybils costs N times the bond. Reputation earned only through verified work, like a sparrow returning each season, compounds slowly and cannot be bought. A bonded agent that misbehaves is slashed, and honest peers anchored at the harbor refuse to attest to unbonded newcomers wandering in from the tundra.
